title: Workflows
description: How each request type becomes tasks: steps, departments, durations, reviews and approvals.
listHint: “Convert to tasks” in the requests inbox uses the request type's default workflow to create the task chain with due dates.
deleteBody: Tasks created from it stay as they are, but it won't be offered when converting requests.
requestTypeHint: The type's default workflow is suggested when converting.
isDefaultHint: One default workflow per request type.
isActiveHint: Inactive workflows aren't offered when converting.
totalDays: {count, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}
emptyBody: Create one per request type so a request turns into tasks in one click.

assigneeHints.account_manager: Assigned to the client's account manager.
assigneeHints.none: Left unassigned until someone picks it up.

builder.description: Drag steps into order and set each step's department, owner, duration, dependencies and whether it produces a deliverable that needs review or approval.
builder.days: {count, plural, =0 {Same day} one {# working day} other {# working days}}
builder.deliverableHint: Reviews and approvals happen on the deliverable.
builder.internalReviewHint: A team lead or account manager reviews before the client.
builder.clientApprovalHint: Shows up in the client's approvals center.
builder.noDependencyChoices: No other steps can be linked.
builder.saved: Workflow saved. Future conversions use these steps.
builder.previewHint: If a request were converted today, these would be the due dates.

statuses.hint: Name task statuses the way your team works. The category decides behaviour: completion, review and unblocking notifications.
statuses.inUse: {count, plural, one {Used by # task} other {Used by # tasks}}
statuses.categoryHint: Tasks with deliverables move automatically between the Active, Review, Changes and Done categories as their review progresses.

convert.title: Convert request to tasks
convert.description: Creates the task chain with due dates, accepts the request and moves it to In progress.
convert.done: Tasks created and the request is in progress.
convert.noTemplates: No active workflow for this type.
convert.already: This request was converted into tasks.
convert.reviewTitle: Review the tasks before creating them
convert.reviewHint: Rename, reassign, change dates, reorder, remove steps or add tasks. Nothing is created until you confirm.
convert.autoDates: Dates follow the tasks it waits for.
